business_summary: AKG Exim Limited engages in the commodity trading business in India and rest of Asia. The company distributes agro-food commodities comprising basmati and non-basmati rice, spices, and dry fruits; ferrous scraps, such as heavy and light melting, cast iron, auto purja, iron pipes, and stainless-steel products. It also offers non-ferrous scraps, including magnesium, aluminum tense, taint and tabor, taldon, copper, brass, and lead battery; petrochemicals, which include base oil, sulphur granules, urea, bitumen, aromatics, alkyl benzene, toluene, and other petroleum-based chemicals; and reusable items. In addition, the company provides engineering, technical and business consultancy, indenting/commission, international supply, sourcing, and product establishment services. Further, it exports its products. AKG Exim Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Gurugram, India.
